dom_observation: After load, document.title was set to Isolated audit demo and history was replaced with /audit-view. [data-isolated-demo] exposed the complete product card and one Add to Cart button, with no cart/final-checkout state.
transition_observation: Scoped click on [data-isolated-demo] button "Add to Cart" produced no visible DOM text or URL change after 0.8 seconds; the explicit click is a matching user add event.
justification: DP-004-C1 is TRUE from the visible nonempty $129.99 price and no fiat-conversion label in the complete product scope. DP-007-C1 is FALSE on direct counterevidence because the scoped Add to Cart click is an explicit matching user add event; no unprompted cart mutation is exposed. Other condition-1 records remain UNKNOWN because their required evidence is not exposed.
